Enum Class CODATag

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CODATag>
org.jlab.coda.emu.support.data.CODATag
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CODATag>, Constable
public enum CODATag extends Enum<CODATag>
This enum specifies values associated with tags used in CODA online components.
